newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong targets 15 pct sales rise in '97.
newsitem.headline: Yukong targets 15 pct sales rise in '97.

text.p: South Korea's largest oil refiner Yukong Ltd said on Thursday it had set this year's sales target at 9.4 trillion won, including 7.6 trillion won in the sales of oil products and 1.5 trillion won in the petrochemical sector.
The target represents a 15 percent rise from 1996, a Yukong statement said without giving comparable figures.

Yukong planned to invest 1.1 trillion won in projects ranging from construction on new facilities, maintenance of existing facilities, overseas oil exploration, construction of environment protection facilities and technology development, the statement said.
